faq: Will this get me to number one on Google?

No one can promise that. We fix what you control: titles, structure, speed and markup. Rankings also depend on content, competitors and links, and the report shows where you stand and what to do next.
Does Wix SEO work as well as other platforms?
Yes, when it is set up properly. Wix gives clean, fast pages and good SEO tools. Most problems come from missing titles, duplicate pages and weak headings, which is where we spend the time.

Can you write blog posts too?
Premium comes with a 90-day content plan, meaning topics and titles. Writing full posts is a separate job we can quote. We never publish text that is spun or copied.
